notes: LUNGING. Intro: the scorpion tail cocks back and holds, strikes over the head at the foe, recoils; the berry and the body hold. Red drupelets are beads over the plum, the glints white. Sport: 'Fall Gold'. Rubus 'Fall Gold' (University of New Hampshire, 1967): golden-amber fruit on yellow-green canes (indexes 1-2 only).
